# momondo

> > momondo is a global travel search and comparison platform that aggregates flights, vacation rentals, and trip planning tools across 1000+ airlines and travel providers.

momondo helps travelers find the cheapest flights, vacation rentals, and accommodations by comparing prices across multiple airlines and booking sites. The platform offers multi-language support and destination-specific deals for major cities worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Flight Search
- Price Comparison
- Cheap Flights
- Flight Deals
- Budget Travel
- Round-trip Flights
- One-way Flights
- Vacation Rentals
- Trip Planning
- Travel Booking
- Price Alerts
- Trending Destinations
- Major Airlines (United, Delta, Frontier, Turkish Airlines)
- US Airports (JFK, LGA, ORD, DFW, BOS, EWR)
- International Destinations (Barcelona, Madrid, Athens, Dubai, Cairo, Mumbai, Ho Chi Minh City)

## Core Travel Search

- [Flight Search & Comparison](https://www.momondo.com/in): Search and compare flights across 1000+ airlines and travel sites with real-time price comparisons
- [Vacation Rentals & Accommodations](https://www.momondo.com/stays): Search and compare vacation rentals, apartments, and hotels across destinations
- [Trip Planner & Itinerary Management](https://www.momondo.com/trips): Organize, manage, and share travel itineraries with the integrated trip planner tool
